valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2026, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 16.72 percent a year from FY2022 (4.82472e+09) to FY2026 (8.95414e+09), over 4 years
valuation.peFormula: market capitalisation / net profit, the same ratio as price / earnings per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.peEpsSource: the filed earnings-per-share row for FY2026
valuation.pbFormula: market capitalisation / total equity, the same ratio as price / book value per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2026
valuation.psFormula: market capitalisation / revenue, the same ratio as price / revenue per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.peCrossCheck: differ by 6%: market cap 154710000000 used (price x shares) vs 146153385390 on file
